acceptanceCriteria: the dispute is settled by an owner-accepted spec amendment or decision, and any resulting fix lands with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Freeze test checks identifiers only; half the Core profiles have no schema or golden (wire-contract high; 1/2). Agreed: `core_freeze_test.go:65-175` asserts identifiers; no schema/golden for affected-plan/0, falsifiable-packet/0, working-tree-impact/0, local-completion/0, index-snapshot/1 or context v1; cli-parity has no cases for context, affected, prove, index, frontier, dogfood; graphDigest drifted uncaught. Split: CCF-V1-002 says it pins identifiers only and relies on per-verb spec tests. Settles it: a committed JSON Schema of the CCF-V1-005 members per profile plus one golden each, or the cross-release replay gate from B6. The chair's view: the graphDigest drift shows the per-verb tests did not catch a member-value change, so the refutation's premise is weaker than stated.
title: panel D4: Freeze test checks identifiers only; half the Core profiles have no schema or golden
